verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time spend visibility as a product capability: "watch spend in real time" on issued cards, "real-time visibility into SaaS spend" with per-vendor cards, and receipts captured and categorized "as soon as you swipe." Slicing by merchant, category and department is supported through MCP and agent queries ("top software vendors by spend," search transactions by merchant, load departments and accounting categories). However, a founder-facing dashboard breaking spend down by team, category and merchant is only implied, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native real-time dashboard with team/category/merchant breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day data freshness.
